vision.name: Cabba
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +2 stages and +2 life cards.
POWER: [Attack] Physical attack.
Focused. You are considered to have no cards in your hand for your effects this combat.
DAMAGE: 6 stages.
HIT: Search your discard pile for up to 2 "Heroes only" and/or [Warning] cards and Rejuvenate them. Your next attack this combat gains "[Warning]: Draw a card."
vision.note: edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badge S (green); black warning triangle transcribed as [Warning]; text zoomed
